授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
電子デバイスに用いられる半導体の性質を理解し、基礎的なデバイス動作原理をエネルギーバンド構造やキャリアの振る舞いに基づいて理解すること。
1. 半導体の特徴
2. 固体のエネルギーバンド構造　（直接遷移//間接遷移，有効質量近似）
3. 半導体への不純物添加　（真性半導体，外因性半導体）
4. 半導体のフェルミ準位とキャリヤ密度　（有効状態密度，キャリヤ密度の温度依存性）
5. 半導体中の電気伝導　（キャリヤ散乱機構，ドリフト電流，拡散電流，キャリヤ連続の式）
6. PN接合　（空乏層，電圧-電流特性，電圧-容量特性）
7. 金属/半導体接触　（ショットキー障壁，電圧-電流特性）
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Semiconductor devices are commonly used in electronic products. By this lecture, students can learn the fundamentals of semiconductor material properties through physics which determine the characteristic of devices, aiming at becoming able to picture the movement of charged particles in head. Notes that lectures on operation principle of transistors are given in “Fundamentals of Transistors” and those on optical semiconductor devices and magnetic devices are given in “Electron Devices II”.
1. Characteristics of semiconductors
2. Energy band structures of solids
Direct/indirect transition, effective mass approximation
3. Impurity doping into semiconductors
Intrinsic semiconductors, extrinsic semiconductors
4. Fermi level and carrier concentration
Effective density of states, temperature dependence of carrier concentration
5. Carrier transport in semiconductors
Carrier scattering mechanisms, drift current, diffusion current, equations for continuity of carriers
6. PN junction
Depletion layer, current-voltage characteristics, capacitance-voltage characteristics
7. Metal-semiconductor contacts
Schottky barrier, current-voltage characteristics
